name: Deakin University
summary: Victorian university with campuses in Melbourne, Geelong and Warrnambool; three trimesters a year, starting in March, July or November.

ib.text: Deakin sets the IB score per course: open the course page and pick your qualification under 'Find the entry requirement for your country'.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)
programmes.about: A four-year honours engineering degree open to international students, with entry in Trimester 1 or Trimester 2 and full-time study.
programmes.ib: Deakin does not print one IB total on the page; select the IB under 'Find the entry requirement for your country' on the course page.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB result against the course's published score for your country.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) for international students: 4 years, Trimester 1 or 2 intake

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science
programmes.about: A three-year science degree covering a broad range of disciplines with practical skills, for international students starting in Trimester 1 or 2.
programmes.ib: Deakin does not print one IB total on the page; select the IB under 'Find the entry requirement for your country' on the course page.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB result against the course's published score for your country.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Science for international students: a broad range of science disciplines, Trimester 1 or 2 intake

notes: Application closing dates vary by intake and by your country, to leave time for visa processing; check the dates for your country before applying for March, July or November.
Fees shown are the first-year amounts on each course page and may rise each year.
